recentItems.title: Voters oust several sheriffs who aided Trump's immigration enforcement efforts
recentItems.description:
Sheriffs in several states who aided President Donald Trump’s immigration crackdown have been ousted from office by voters, all losing to challengers opposed to cooperative agreements with Immigration, Customs and Enforcement. (AP Video/Allen G. Breed, Sarah Rankin)

recentItems.title: This runner has completed over 70 marathons. This year, she ran 7 of them while pregnant
recentItems.description: Deirdre Keane had already run more than 60 marathons when she decided to take on a new challenge of completing the World Marathon Majors. She just didn’t expect to be running them while pregnant.

recentItems.title: How water specialists go door to door to save every drop in drought-stricken Arizona city
recentItems.description:
For over two decades, Tucson Water has offered free in-person water-efficiency checkups to identify waste from leaking toilets and overwatered yards in Arizona's second-largest city. Dozens of cities in the West are following suit as water supplies grow more scarce. (AP video by Brittany Peterson)

recentItems.title: Endurance athlete swims in Strait of Hormuz to highlight the war's impact on wildlife
recentItems.description:
British endurance swimmer Lewis Pugh has swum the Strait of Hormuz to highlight environmental threats amid ongoing conflict. Pugh, a United Nations Patron of the Oceans, completed the swim this week despite nearby attacks on vessels. (AP Video/Kwiyeon Ha)

recentItems.title: Trump praises Democratic leaders as 'smart' and hopes to get 'more done'
recentItems.description:
